infoLinks.urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weeknight closures due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 2 to Wednesday 4 February, nightly from 8pm to 1am, L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines light rail services will be impacted by closures due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time:
  • L1 Dulwich Hill line light rail services will not run.
  • Use alternative transport including L1 replacement bus services, regular bus services or walking if able to between Central Grand Concourse and Dulwich Hill.
  • L2 and L3 light rail services will not run between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street. L2 and L3 light rail services will continue running between Central and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford as per normal schedule.
  • Use alternative transport including trains, metro, regular bus services or walking if able to between Circular Quay and Central.
L1 replacement bus services:
 
Nightly from 8pm to 1am, replacement bus services will run between Central Grand Concourse and Dulwich Hill as follows:
  • From 8pm to 9pm: every 10 to 15 min
  • From 9pm to 1am: every 15 to 20 min.
These times may vary depending on road traffic.
 
Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
  • Capitol Square (towards Central and Dulwich Hill / The Star) - Please use the alternative stop at Central Grand Concourse or walk to Central Station (approx. 7 minute walk),
  • Exhibition Centre (towards Dulwich Hill / The Star) - Please use the alternative stop at Convention (approx. 7 minute walk),
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
 
Where the replacement bus has an opal reader onboard, and you must tap on and tap off. A standard light rail fare applies. 
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
 
L1, L2 and L3 light rail services will resume as normal, daily from 5am to 8pm on Tuesday 3 and Wednesday 4 February, and from 5am Thursday 5 February.

  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 3am, some trains from Central to Central Coast & Newcastle Line stations run to a changed timetable and make extra stops at Asquith, Mount Colah and Mount Kuring-gai.

  • Thursday and Friday, buses replace the 01:47 Central to Newcastle Interchange service from Central to Gosford. Replacement buses leave Central at 1.21am, 26 minutes earlier than the normal train timetable.
